applies_why: This judge text resolves an Isaiah 7:14 link by dividing challenger wording from defender application rather than weighing the parties' pressed chains by footing.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: (1) requires whole-chain footing comparison, not splitting a verse's wording from its application; (2) permits splitting wording and application as separate sub-issues.
why: Because the judge text splits the Isaiah 7:14 dispute into challenger wording and defender application and declares it underdetermined without weighing the pressed chains by footing, it does not comply with K-C.
